- **Linux** (Ubuntu 26.04, Steam, Dead Cells 35): the 0.3.1 launcher from this page, on a new folder: checks, setup and a short test run as Kirby. Your saves were backed up and left unchanged. Before this release, Kirby walked, landed and rode elevators in test runs, standing on the floor art.
- **Windows 11**: the fixes in this version were played on a Windows 11 PC with a 75 Hz screen and an Xbox One controller, from a test build of the same code: a new run as Kirby with Steam's overlay on, elevator rides and standing on planks. The download on this page itself was only checked in a Windows-compatible environment on Linux (Wine): the launcher's checks.
- **Not tested yet:** this Windows download on a real Windows 11 PC, a controller in the launcher, the Steam Deck and other PCs. If you try it, tell us how it went!
